d: The princess is shocked by how the ministers are proclaiming their concerns to the king about the way she has been acting.
The prince has come from Qing China to ask for the princesss hand in marriage.
The Qing China Prince is growing ever so fond of the princess and Kyun-woo realizes that he can no longer keep his emotions a secret.
The King announces that he will interrogate the Minister of Taxation himself to find out if there are any accomplices but he breaks free from jail one day.
Princess Hye Myung loses a chance to get the traces of her mother because of Kyun-woo.
The Ghost Mask distributes flyers that says the Queen was dethroned 10 years ago
